title: 第9章 我父亲要见你第10章 总有你求我的时候
lines: 陆婉儿对养父的感情是敬畏中透着一点惧意。
大多人家皆是如此，父亲这一角色总隔着一段不近不远的距离，他们平日不出声，一出声绝非好事。
陆婉儿清楚记得，那晚书房中父亲告诫她，不许她同谢家人往来，说谢容有婚约在身，那么这会儿召她前去所为何事？
心里这么想着，下意识往戴缨身上看了一眼，眼光流转，对戴缨莞尔一笑，说道：“我父亲要见你，姐姐随我走一趟罢。”
陆婉儿担心父亲的责问，便把戴缨薅上，真若质问起来，就让戴缨出面，道明她同谢容已解除婚约。
这样一来，既怪不到她的头上，也怪不到谢容的头上，就是一件顺其自然的事。
戴缨怔了怔，惊惑道：“陆相要见我？”
这位大人为何要见她？
适才她在陆老夫人跟前坐着，听见她吩咐仆从，引谢家父子前去见一见，难道谢容在那位大人面前说了什么？
戴缨心思渐重，烦郁起来，害怕横生枝节，只好随陆婉儿折回寺庙后院。
几人走到最深处，守门小厮往里报知，不一会儿出来。
“大人让小娘子进去。”
陆婉儿转头对戴缨道：“我先进去，一会儿传你，你再进来。”
戴缨点头，立在外间，谢珍没得传唤，也在外间候着。
“表姐好本事，今日这一出把咱们都戏耍了，果然‘末业之徒’狡诈。”
谢珍侧过头，一双眼狠狠咬着戴缨。
虽说行商乃末业，可公然呼出便是非常不客气。
谢珍这副贪婪恶毒的嘴脸一点不输她娘。
戴缨敛下眼皮，嘴角牵起一抹笑：“末业之徒？劝你这个词莫要乱用，别叫骂到自己身上。”
谢珍涨红着脸，虽气怔，到底不敢再说，真要追根溯源，她母亲也是末业之徒。
禅房里间，窗扇开着……
屋内萦纡着淡淡的檀香，混合着雨后草木的清香。
壁面挂着一幅水墨山水，烟云苍茫，题着万籁俱寂，画下是长案，错落垒着几摞封套好的经卷，经卷旁是一鼎紫铜香炉，白烟中绕着一缕紫调，依依上升。
地上铺着打磨光滑的青砖，靠窗设一张花梨木榻，榻上置小几，几上摆着棋盘，上面散布着黑白子。
整个禅房器物不多，却件件精雅，风动，窗外的竹叶簌簌响起，破开岑寂。
天光从格子窗筛进来，凭空剪成斑驳辉动的光影，落在棋盘之上。
案几边坐着一人，他的手边是一盏白瓷杯温茶，在他右侧的一溜交椅中，坐着一个清俊的年轻男子。
年轻男子正襟危坐，双手撑于腿上，腰背直起，目光微垂。
这人正是谢容。
而上首之人正是陆婉儿之父，陆铭章。
content_en:
Lu Wan'er's feelings towards her adoptive father were a mixture of awe and a little fear.
This is the case for most families. The role of father is always at a distance that is neither close nor far away. They usually remain silent, and it is never a good thing if they do.
Lu Wan'er clearly remembered that her father warned her in the study that night that she was not allowed to interact with the Xie family, saying that Xie Rong was engaged, so why did he call her there now?
With this thought in mind, he glanced at Dai Ying subconsciously, his eyes moved, he smiled at Dai Ying and said, "My father wants to see you, sister, please come with me."
Lu Waner was worried about her father's accusation, so she pulled Dai Ying over. If she really questioned him, she asked Dai Ying to come forward and explain that she and Xie Rong had terminated their engagement.
In this way, neither she nor Xie Rong was to blame, it was just a matter of letting nature take its course.
Dai Ying was startled and said in surprise: "Mr. Lu wants to see me?"
Why does this gentleman want to see her?
Just now she was sitting in front of Mrs. Lu, and she heard her ordering her servants to lead the Xie family and his son to have a meeting. Could it be that Xie Rong said something in front of that adult?
Dai Ying became more and more worried and depressed. She was afraid of complications, so she had to follow Lu Wan'er back to the temple backyard.
A few people walked to the deepest part, and the guard guard came inside to report the news, and came out soon.
"Sir, please let me in."
Lu Wan'er turned to Dai Ying and said, "I'll go in first, I'll call you later, and you can come in again."
Dai Ying nodded and stood outside. Xie Zhen didn't have to be summoned, so she was also waiting outside.
"My cousin is very capable. She made a fool of us all today. It turns out that the 'disciple' is cunning."
Xie Zhen turned her head and bit Dai Ying fiercely with her eyes.
Although it is said that doing business is the last profession, it is very rude to exhale it openly.
Xie Zhen's greedy and vicious face is not inferior to her mother's at all.
Dai Ying lowered her eyelids and raised a smile at the corner of her mouth: "A disciple of the last generation? I advise you not to use this word indiscriminately, so as not to curse yourself."
"You..."
Xie Zhen blushed. Although she was stunned, she did not dare to say anything anymore. If she really wanted to trace the source, her mother was also a destitute person.
…
In the inner room of the Zen room, the window sash is open...
There is a faint scent of sandalwood lingering in the house, mixed with the fragrance of grass and trees after the rain.
Hanging on the wall is an ink painting of a landscape with vast smoke and clouds, and the title "Everything is silent". Below the painting is a long desk with several stacks of enveloped scriptures scattered around. Next to the scriptures is a copper incense burner, with a wisp of purple swirling around in the white smoke, rising slowly.
The floor was paved with smooth polished blue bricks, and a rosewood couch was set up by the window. There was a small table on the couch, with a chessboard on it, and black and white pieces scattered on it.
There are not many utensils in the whole Zen room, but everything is exquisite. The wind blows, and the bamboo leaves outside the window rustle, breaking the silence.
The skylight filtered in through the lattice window, cut into mottled light and shadow out of thin air, and fell on the chessboard.
There is a person sitting next to the desk, with a white porcelain cup of warm tea in his hand. On the right side of him, sitting in a chair, is a handsome young man.
The young man sat upright, with his hands on his legs, his back straight, and his eyes slightly lowered.
This person is Xie Rong.
The person at the head was none other than Lu Waner's father, Lu Mingzhang.
title_en: Chapter 9 My father wants to see you Chapter 10 There will always be a time when you beg me
